changelog: Gameplay Rework v0.6.0: start menu (Single Player / Multiplayer). Single Player: Tower Defense on a purpose-built map (Forge building lives here, and only here - defend a 1000-HP core, leaked enemies damage it), Team Deathmatch vs bots (first to 25, pick a loadout + exactly one traversal tool: grapple / jetpack / portal gun), and CoD-style Zombies on a flat town map (buy doors, randomized perks incl. always a health perk, wall buys, Mystery Box incl. mod weapons, Pack-a-Punch 5000 + re-Pack 2000). Multiplayer: co-op TD, co-op Zombies, PvP TDM + bot fill. Movement reworked: wall-run only at full speed + aimed/parallel + 50% entry boost, hold-jump = higher wall-jump, slide camera lowered (stand 1.6 / crouch 1.05 / slide 0.85), new fuel-based jetpack. New Cinder City urban map for grapple swings. Enemies redone: distinct per-type behaviour + procedural animation (limb swing, attack wind-up, hit reactions, death). Base Defense stays as legacy (registered + startable, hidden from the new menu).
